HEAD_defined.name: Head Center (Defined)
HEAD_defined.headline: A consistent source of inspiration
HEAD_defined.body: You have a stable pattern of inspiration and questions. Ideas and curiosities come from within; you're not easily pulled into thinking about something just because outside pressure says so.

HEAD_undefined.name: Head Center (Undefined / Open)
HEAD_undefined.headline: A magnet for other people's questions and inspirations
HEAD_undefined.body: You amplify the mental pressure around you. Other people's questions feel like yours, even when they're not.
HEAD_undefined.gift: The wisdom to know which questions are worth answering and which to let go. You can read what others are obsessing over.
HEAD_undefined.shadow: Flooded by questions that aren't yours — overthinking things that don't actually matter.

AJNA_defined.name: Ajna Center (Defined)
AJNA_defined.headline: A fixed, reliable way of thinking
AJNA_defined.body: How you process ideas and build concepts is consistent — your thinking pattern is available on demand. That's why people come to you to think things through.

AJNA_undefined.name: Ajna Center (Undefined / Open)
AJNA_undefined.headline: Flexible mind — doesn't need to always be sure
AJNA_undefined.body: Your thinking shifts. Mental certainty isn't your strength — what's stable is the ability to see many angles.
AJNA_undefined.gift: Can hold multiple perspectives without fixing on one. Great for brainstorming and seeing what others miss because they're too certain.
AJNA_undefined.shadow: Pretending to be certain, or doubling down to look like you have an answer when the underlying knowledge isn't stable.

THROAT_defined.name: Throat Center (Defined)
THROAT_defined.headline: Can access expression and manifestation on demand
THROAT_defined.body: You can speak when you want, manifest through voice and language. Which channel reaches your Throat determines how you most naturally express.

THROAT_undefined.name: Throat Center (Undefined / Open)
THROAT_undefined.headline: Your voice is strongest when invited
THROAT_undefined.body: You don't always have easy access to speaking. Your voice is most natural and lands best when others draw you out, not when you push yourself to be heard.
THROAT_undefined.gift: A voice that resonates at the right moment. Can stay silent in peace when energy isn't ready to come out.
THROAT_undefined.shadow: Forcing yourself to speak for attention, then feeling rejected because the timing wasn't right.

G_defined.name: G Center (Defined)
G_defined.headline: A stable identity and direction
G_defined.body: You know who you are and where you're going. That sense of self doesn't shake easily with the environment.

G_undefined.name: G Center (Undefined / Open)
G_undefined.headline: Fluid identity — needs the right place
G_undefined.body: Your identity and sense of direction shifts with place and people. That's not a weakness — it pulls you toward the right environment.
G_undefined.gift: Can connect with many identities. When you're in the right place, the right identity emerges naturally.
G_undefined.shadow: Forcing a specific identity in a place that doesn't fit, or feeling lost because the environment is holding you back.

HEART_defined.name: Heart / Ego Center (Defined)
HEART_defined.headline: Willpower available on commitment
HEART_defined.body: You can promise and follow through. Your will energy is consistent — when you commit to something, you can see it through.

HEART_undefined.name: Heart / Ego Center (Undefined / Open)
HEART_undefined.headline: Will that comes in bursts — don't force consistency
HEART_undefined.body: Your commitment energy comes and goes. When it's there, it's strong. When it's not, don't force it.
HEART_undefined.gift: Can learn self-worth that doesn't come from proving anything. Knows when to say yes and when to say no.
HEART_undefined.shadow: Overpromising and burning out trying to prove yourself. Or feeling you always have to 'prove worth' that doesn't actually need proving.

SACRAL_defined.name: Sacral Center (Defined)
SACRAL_defined.headline: A stable engine of work energy
SACRAL_defined.body: You have consistent stamina for work, as long as the direction fits. Your sacral responds yes/no for your decisions.

SACRAL_undefined.name: Sacral Center (Undefined / Open)
SACRAL_undefined.headline: Energy that needs guarding — not endless
SACRAL_undefined.body: You amplify other people's energy when you're near them, but your own reserves aren't unlimited.
SACRAL_undefined.gift: Sensitive to others' energy — can sense when they're tired. Knows when to stop, unlike a Generator who can keep pushing.
SACRAL_undefined.shadow: Forcing yourself to push like a Generator until burnout. Forgetting to stop because the surrounding energy is still running.

SOLAR_PLEXUS_defined.name: Solar Plexus Center (Defined)
SOLAR_PLEXUS_defined.headline: Have your own emotional wave
SOLAR_PLEXUS_defined.body: Your moods rise and fall in a consistent pattern. Learn the wave — it's your decision-making authority.

SOLAR_PLEXUS_undefined.name: Solar Plexus Center (Undefined / Open)
SOLAR_PLEXUS_undefined.headline: Sensitive to others' emotions
SOLAR_PLEXUS_undefined.body: You absorb emotions from those around you. Other people's mood can feel like your own — that's what gets confusing.
SOLAR_PLEXUS_undefined.gift: An empath who can read a room without being asked. Knows how to soothe others because you feel them.
SOLAR_PLEXUS_undefined.shadow: Extreme conflict avoidance — fleeing uncomfortable emotions you think are yours but are actually borrowed.

SPLEEN_defined.name: Spleen Center (Defined)
SPLEEN_defined.headline: Consistent survival intuition
SPLEEN_defined.body: Your instincts are live — when danger is near, you sense it. Your physical immunity is relatively strong too.

SPLEEN_undefined.name: Spleen Center (Undefined / Open)
SPLEEN_undefined.headline: Tend to hold onto unhealthy things longer than you should
SPLEEN_undefined.body: You tend to hang onto situations or relationships that have expired, out of fear of change. You're also more sensitive to your physical health.
SPLEEN_undefined.gift: Can read with precision what's healthy and what isn't. When you trust that pattern, you choose what's good for you.
SPLEEN_undefined.shadow: Gripping on to what no longer fits — relationships, jobs, habits — out of fear of letting go.

ROOT_defined.name: Root Center (Defined)
ROOT_defined.headline: A stable, managed source of pressure
ROOT_defined.body: You can handle pressure at your own pace. The pressure to act is consistently present — you set the tempo, not the other way.

ROOT_undefined.name: Root Center (Undefined / Open)
ROOT_undefined.headline: Vulnerable to pressure to rush
ROOT_undefined.body: You absorb pressure from around you and easily rush. When others panic, you tend to follow without noticing.
ROOT_undefined.gift: Can learn which pressure is actually yours and which is borrowed. Once you can tell, you can work at the right tempo.
ROOT_undefined.shadow: Constantly rushing — as if there's a deadline that isn't real. An unhealthy adrenaline addiction.
